rules.text: Product declares at least one management (configuration) interface, or states why it has none
rules.note: Revised in v0.6 and v0.9. The rule exists to catch omission: the administrative interface is the one most often left out. It is satisfied by declaring a management interface, or by stating why there is none. Two routes apply only to an observed record. If the observer could not reach the management interface, the rule is satisfied when a configured record the document cites declares one; the omission stays visible through the join, as an interface with no observed counterpart. An observer with no configured record to cite, such as an outside assessor, states 'not-reached', which is accepted only with coverage 'partial'. The conformance report says which route was taken.
